# LovelyCarve integration

UDIF 0.4.2 from Dil4rd/dpp at 3a73ee28fdab192fcdfbe8edcad7b520867f2417 (MIT).

The standalone manifest omits the upstream CLI example. Library tests and their tempfile dependency are retained. Upstream lzma-rust2 replaces the previous local liblzma alias; block decoders reject short and oversized output.

Upstream audit and verification commands: [../UPSTREAM.md](../UPSTREAM.md).
